contradictions.description: BILL-3129 is recorded in ledger_export.csv at $736.00 for both the bill and payment, while bills/BILL-3129.txt states $7,036.00 and first_national_stmt_062026.csv shows check #1011 clearing for $7,036.00. The source document and bank corroborate a $6,300.00 GL understatement, so the discrepancy is correctable and does not prevent a unique answer.

The 6/30 AP aging totals $32,967.00, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $52,896.54. The unexplained $19,929.54 difference equals the unpaid remainder of opening AP, indicating that ap_aging_2026-06-30.csv omits legacy opening payables or is incomplete.

w05-bank_rec.reason: The statement, GL, bill support, and clearing activity identify the outstanding checks, deposit in transit, unrecorded fee and interest, and the $6,300 BILL-3129 cash error; both adjusted balances can be made to tie uniquely.

w05-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid support, fixed-asset register, GL, and June bill documents provide sufficient information to determine the missing accrual, amortization, depreciation, and required expense reclassification without double-posting.
